name: Flint
description: Knapped flint: a conchoidal flake with the bulb of percussion still on it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 2%, 78% 22%, 94% 56%, 66% 96%, 30% 92%, 8% 60%, 18% 24%); clip-path: polygon(50% 2%, 78% 22%, 94% 56%, 66% 96%, 30% 92%, 8% 60%, 18% 24%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 30% 34% 26% 22%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
